author: b. l. moreno
title: Key dates announced for the June 2026 primary election
text:
Officials announced on May 5 several important dates for voters ahead of the June primary election. The polls will be open from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. on June 2, providing residents with the opportunity to cast their ballots.
The announcement highlights key deadlines that voters should be aware of in order to participate in the upcoming election. These include registration and mail-in ballot deadlines, as well as information about early voting options.
According to the information released, May 12 is the last day for individuals to register to vote in time for the June primary. Those who wish to vote by mail must apply by May 26 if submitting their application through postal mail. Early voting will take place from May 26 through May 31 at designated polling locations within Morris County; details about specific sites and hours can be found at www.morriscountynj.gov.
For those opting for a mail-in ballot, June 2 is also the final day for in-person submission, with ballots due by 8:00 p.m.
These dates are intended to ensure all eligible voters have ample opportunity and information needed to participate in this year’s primary process.
